title: Google's Sashiko AI Has Completed 191k Patch Reviews, Cited On Nearly 500 Kernel CVEs
summary: Google基于AI的Sashiko系统已完成19.1万次Linux内核补丁审查，并被近500个CVE引用，成为AI在系统安全领域最具规模落地的案例之一
body:
Google基于AI的Sashiko系统已完成19.1万次Linux内核补丁审查，并被近500个CVE引用，成为AI在系统安全领域最具规模落地的案例之一

Source: https://www.phoronix.com/news/Sashiko-Linux-AI-Metrics
summary_en: Google's AI-based Sashiko system has completed 191,000 Linux kernel patch reviews and has been cited in nearly 500 CVEs, marking one of the most significant real-world deployments of AI in systems security. The system represents a major milestone in automated vulnerability detection within open-source software development, demonstrating how AI can enhance code auditing processes at scale. This achievement highlights the growing importance of machine learning in identifying potential security weaknesses across large, complex codebases. Source: Phoronix.
